title: crossingIndex is a total, axiom-free bucket index for a level crossing
statement: CReal.crossingIndex a b eps : Nat computes, for two CReal endpoints and a positive rational mesh eps, the bucket index at which a value crossing between a and b is located to within that mesh. A total, axiom-free definition -- NOT an exact-crossing search: an exact construction would require deciding which side of an exact crossing a value falls on, an undecidable comparison this construction deliberately avoids (creal/ivt.rs refutes the analogous exact-root construction with two kernel-computed counterexamples).

formal.statement: def CReal.crossingIndex : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> ((x2 : Rat) -> AxNat)))
